# Insane logging for some host calls

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

This PR adds dumping of full byte blobs in case of insane logging for some host calls.

## Walkthrough

This PR adds insane-level logging statements to 7 JAM host-call files to capture full, non-truncated values in addition to existing truncated trace logs. The modified files are `accumulate/provide.ts`, `general/fetch.ts`, `general/lookup.ts`, `general/read.ts`, `general/write.ts`, `refine/export.ts`, and `refine/machine.ts`. Each receives a single new logger.insane call that logs complete data without truncation. No functional behavior, control flow, or public API changes are introduced.

**Avoid stringifying full `value` in insane log; it will execute regardless of log level.**

Tagged template expressions like `${value}` are always evaluated by JavaScript before the function is called, so this will stringify the entire object even when insane logging is disabled. Use `value?.toStringTruncated()` here too, or check the log level explicitly before logging.

Also, this file contains multiple graypaper links with outdated versions (`v=0.6.6`). Update them to `v=0.7.2` per guidelines.
